title: ALP Execution Envelope
description: Transport-neutral envelope that carries an executable ALP payload plus delivery, ordering, and idempotency metadata. Contains no wall-clock or transport-specific fields so that envelope identity stays deterministic.

protocol_version.description: Governed by spec/alp-governance-v0.2.md. 0.1 is deprecated but accepted.

envelope_id.description: Content-derived identity: sha256(canonical(stream_id, sequence, payload.content_hash))[:32]. Not random, so the same logical send always produces the same id.

idempotency_key.description: Dedup key. Defaults to envelope_id. Two envelopes with the same key must execute at most once.

stream_id.description: Ordering domain. Ordering is guaranteed within a stream_id and undefined across streams.

sequence.description: Monotonic position within stream_id. First accepted sequence for a stream establishes the baseline; later envelopes must be contiguous.

max_attempts.description: Upper bound on execution attempts, including the first.

deadline_ms.description: Logical-time budget for the whole delivery, measured against the transport logical clock, not wall clock. null means no deadline.

reply_to.description: Optional transport-specific return address. Opaque to the runtime and excluded from envelope identity.

kind.description: bundle = .alpp.json or .alppb exchange bundle; module = bare .alp module.
